title: A Gunman Saw a God of Death Nobody Else Could See, Then Ran Straight to His Death . . . (Episode 4)
caption:
In Death Note episode 4, a bus gunman suddenly sees Ryuk, the god of death nobody else can see.
Jack turns a hijacking into a trap to learn the name of the FBI agent following him. Follow for episode 5!

#deathnote #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #fyp
comment: Jack used a bus full of strangers as bait to get one name. Genius or monster? Why?

segments.say: A gunman on a bus sees a monster that nobody else can see, and minutes later he is *dead*.
To see how it got here, go back one night, to Jack's dark *bedroom*.
Ryuk has just made him an offer. The Shinigami *eyes*, for half of his remaining life.
With those eyes, Jack could see anyone's name just by looking at their *face*.
Jack thinks it over. Then he gives his *answer*.

segments.text: This deal is... out of the question.

segments.say: He wants to wipe out evil and rule the new world as a god for a very *long* time. Dying early ruins that plan.
Ryuk just grins. He only wanted Jack to know the deal *existed*. Classic Ryuk, always stirring the pot.
So Jack snaps at him. Why not say so on day *one*, or write it in the rules?
Ryuk is amused. This human is not scared of a god of death at *all*.
Then Jack jokes that he would take *wings* instead. Ryuk says the police would catch a flying boy in a day.
But then Ryuk turns serious. The Shinigami realm is *rotting*. Gods of death only kill because they are scared to die.
He says Jack is already a better Shinigami than any of them. Jack hates that. He is a *human*, helping humans.
So he tells a god of death to go home and *fix* his own world. Ryuk laughs. What a positive thinker.
A cheerful word for a mass *murderer*.
Then Jack smiles. He has a way to find the *name* of the man who followed him today.
But first he must learn how far the Death Note can *control* a death.
So the next morning, police headquarters gets a strange *call*. Six more prisoners died overnight.
All heart attacks. But before dying, one drew a *pentagram* on his cell wall in his own blood.
One wrote an odd letter. And one ran to the staff bathroom and died on the *floor*.
L studies the pictures. Kira might control not just when people die, but what they *do* first.
So he tells the chief to keep it all from the *media*. Kira must never see his own results.
The cops call it a sick *game* with human lives. They are right. They just don't know who is playing.
That night, Jack reads the test results right off his father's *computer*.
All three did *exactly* what he wrote. The bathroom, the pentagram, the letter, word for word.
The other three got *impossible* orders. One had to die at the Eiffel Tower within an hour, from a prison in Japan.
One had to draw L's face. Nobody can draw a face they have never *seen*.
And one had to write a secret about L he could never know. All three just had heart *attacks*.
So the rule is simple. The Death Note can't do the *impossible*. But anything a person could do, Jack controls.
That is terrifying power for a high school *kid*.
Meanwhile L stares at the pentagram and the letter, hunting for a hidden *message*.
There isn't one. Jack left them there just to waste L's *time*.
Now for the real thing. Jack picks a drug addict from the news, a man who tried to rob a *bank*.
Then he calls around, because he is a very popular guy. One call wakes up a *girl*, and she says yes to a date.
The next day, the man in the dark coat is still *following* him.
Perfect. Without the stalker, this date would be a waste of *time*.
Ryuk asks for the plan. Jack says it's all in the Death Note, but Ryuk won't read it. That would ruin the *fun*.
The girl is thrilled. To her, this is just a normal *date*.
Behind them, the stalker takes *notes*. Top student, cop's son, nothing to suspect.
He decides today is his last day *watching* this boy. That was his first mistake.
They all ride the same bus. And at the next stop, the drug addict climbs *aboard*.
Jack knows that face. The man walks up the aisle and pulls out a *gun*.

segments.text: Stay in your seats unless you want to die!

segments.say: He makes the driver call the park for all of yesterday's cash, or every passenger *dies*.
Jack slips the girl a *note*. When the gunman turns, he will grab the gun.
But the stalker leans in. Too risky, he whispers. He will handle it *himself*.
So Jack turns on him. How does he know this man isn't the gunman's *partner*?
The agent is sure Jack isn't Kira. Kira would just give the gunman a heart *attack*. Wrong. He is sitting right next to Kira.
So he proves it with his *FBI* badge. And there is his name, right on the card. Ray Penber.
The hunter just handed over his own *name*.
Then the gunman storms to the back, and Jack lets the note *drop*.
The gunman grabs it, reads the plan to take his gun, and *laughs*.
He should never have touched that *paper*.
Because now he looks to the back of the bus, and *freezes*. Something is sitting there.
That note was torn from the Death Note. Anyone who touches it can see *Ryuk*.
The gunman panics and empties his gun at the god of *death*.
Everyone else just sees a madman shooting at empty *air*.
Even Ryuk is impressed. Jack turned a hijacking into a perfect *trap*.
Screaming, the gunman throws himself off the *bus*.
He crawls onto the road. At exactly 11:45, a car hits him. He is *dead*.
The girl stares in *shock*. Ray Penber steps off the bus, shaken.
It all went just as Jack wrote it. The bus, the phantom, the gun, the *car*.
Jack smiles. The Death Note never *fails*.
He has the stalker's name now. And Ray Penber has no idea he is *next*.
